recipes.name: One-tray Mediterranean salmon with olives and capers

steps.name: Preheat and prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). While it heats, halve the potatoes, cut the onion into wedges and slice the peppers.

steps.name: Roast the base
steps.text: Toss the potatoes, onion and peppers with the oil, paprika and oregano and roast for 10 minutes. Meanwhile cut the courgettes into half-moons and slice the lemon.

steps.name: Add the salmon
steps.text: Add the courgettes, tomatoes, olives and capers, sit the salmon on top with the lemon slices and roast for 8 minutes.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Set half aside for tomorrow and plate. Pierre-Guy: 520g. Mariska: 350g.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently, covered, in a pan for 4 to 5 min until piping hot, or eat the fish cold.

recipes.name: Halloumi traybake with oregano new potatoes and tzatziki

steps.name: Preheat and prep
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). While it heats, halve the potatoes, cut the onion into wedges and slice the peppers.

steps.name: Roast the base
steps.text: Toss the potatoes, onion and peppers with the oil and oregano and roast for 12 minutes. Meanwhile chunk the courgettes, then grate the cucumber, crush the garlic, chop the mint and mix the tzatziki.

steps.name: Add the halloumi
steps.text: Add the courgettes and tomatoes, lay the sliced halloumi on top and roast for 6 minutes.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Plate with the tzatziki. Pierre-Guy: 480g and 80g tzatziki. Mariska: 320g and 55g tzatziki.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat in a pan with a splash of water until piping hot. Keep the tzatziki cold and separate.

recipes.name: Psari plaki: Greek cod in tomato and oregano
equipment: Large deep frying pan with lid

steps.name: Kettle and potatoes
steps.text: Put the kettle on, then halve the potatoes.

steps.name: Boil and soften
steps.text: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, adding the beans for the last 4 minutes. Meanwhile slice the onions and soften them in the oil in the frying pan, mince the garlic and trim the beans before they go in.

steps.name: Make the sauce
steps.text: Add the garlic, purée, tomatoes and oregano to the onions and simmer for 3 minutes.

steps.name: Cook the cod
steps.text: Sit the cod in the sauce, cover and cook for 6 minutes until it flakes. Chop the parsley while it cooks.

steps.name: Finish and plate
steps.text: Drain the potatoes and beans, squeeze lemon over the fish, scatter with parsley and plate. Pierre-Guy: 520g. Mariska: 350g.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.storage: Cool within 1 hour and refrigerate. Reheat gently, covered, in a pan for 4 to 5 min until piping hot, or eat the fish cold.

recipes.name: Greek salad with crispy lemon-oregano tofu
ingredients: Dressing: 1½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Dressing: ½ tsp dried oregano, a pinch of salt

steps.name: Prep the tofu
steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and cut it into cubes.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Toss the tofu with the cornflour, oil, lemon zest and oregano.

steps.name: Air fry
steps.text: Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking halfway. Meanwhile dice the cucumbers, halve the tomatoes, slice the pepper and onion, and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Cool
steps.text: Let the tofu cool for 2 minutes.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes with the feta, olives and seeds on top. Pierre-Guy: 430g and 20g dressing. Mariska: 290g and 15g dressing.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.packing: Dressing in its own pot, tofu on top so it stays crisp.

recipes.name: Italian egg, fennel and chicory salad with Parmesan and walnuts
ingredients: Dressing: 1½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
Dressing: 1 tsp Dijon mustard (GF), a pinch of salt

steps.name: Boil the water
steps.text: Boil the kettle and bring a pan of water back to the boil.

steps.name: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes. Meanwhile thinly slice the fennel, separate the chicory leaves, chop the capers and whisk the dressing.

steps.name: Cool
steps.text: Cool the eggs in cold water.

steps.name: Peel
steps.text: Peel and halve the eggs.

steps.name: Cheese and nuts
steps.text: Shave the Parmesan and break up the walnuts.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 330g with 5 egg halves and 20g dressing. Mariska: 220g with 3 egg halves and 15g dressing.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.flag: Egg recipe: adjust breakfast on these days. Time is over 30 min.

recipes.name: Spanish Manchego, orange and almond salad with smoked-paprika yoghurt
ingredients: Whipped yoghurt: 1 tsp sweet smoked paprika
Whipped yoghurt: ½ lemon, 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, a pinch of salt

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the almonds and seeds in a dry pan.

steps.name: Oranges
steps.text: Peel and slice the oranges.

steps.name: Radishes
steps.text: Slice the radishes.

steps.name: Onion
steps.text: Thinly slice the onion.

steps.name: Gem
steps.text: Shred the gem.

steps.name: Manchego
steps.text: Dice the Manchego.

steps.name: Whip the yoghurt
steps.text: Whip the yoghurt with the paprika, lemon, oil and salt.

steps.name: Box up
steps.text: Divide everything into 4 boxes. Pierre-Guy: 330g and 75g yoghurt. Mariska: 220g and 50g yoghurt.

recipes.note: Rebuilt from the plan log: the dish and timing are as approved, the method and figures are reconstructed estimates.
recipes.packing: Yoghurt in its own pot, gem on top.
